improvements: Current native scene retains 65 source building records and validates the source geometry cache; no membership count establishes architectural parity.
Actual 192.589 m entry-to-terminal-disc walk and real award; earlier native kayak strokes; actual phone three-release stone practice
The selected primary activity approach is accepted separately from full-scene comparison.

The mapped retaining wall w1496390046 keeps its footprint and rocks; its unsupported estimated cap beneath the existing raised public pier is constrained below the rendered deck triangles. The native entry-to-terminal traversal verifies the crossing.
District fidelity pass, 91f5bf7 (range 332ae423..346f7986): Covered moorage and the pier sundial were added.

Fidelity pass round 2, 9824fd5 (range 94a177d5..9824fd56): The pavilion is set into the bank with a public roof terrace, whaling building and boathouse in dark brown boards, covered-moorage sheds over the yacht-club footprints, mapped piers and buoys, a sloped Lake Washington Blvd bridge deck, a fir belt on the far shores, new promenade lights, the park sign at the entrance, and a paddle loop round the marina.
Fidelity pass round 3, 2b1a251 (range 9824fd56..2b1a2511): 152 far-shore houses, the bridge on upright piers, grey cobra-head lamps on Lake Washington Blvd and a 17-step stair with handrails.
remainingGaps: Generic tour planner still rejects the route; actual terminal traversal does not prove kayak reload or full bay fidelity
Complete matched independent scene, entry and architectural/reference comparison remains open; source membership and cache hits are not visual parity.
Route/controller proof does not certify every secondary activity, completed-save persistence or full phone-thumbstick coverage.
Virtual boating practice does not confirm real staffed rental hardware, current operator hours or operating dates; distant shore/context fidelity remains incomplete.
Retaining-wall height and pier grade remain model estimates; the physical clearance correction is not an independent real-world height survey.
Validation frames, native proofs, source-geometry counts and performance figures in this record predate 2b1a251 and were not re-run for round 3.

nativeProofs.label: Native desktop explicit paddle strokes

nativeProofs.label: Native touch explicit paddle strokes
nativeProofs.scope: Actual explicit strokes complete the selected short course; idle/early Leave do not award and mode cancellation restores shore. Nearby launch setup is not the park-entry route. Completed boat reload remains unverified.

nativeProofs.label: Native phone three-release stone practice
nativeProofs.scope: Only the named cases pass: real native inputs, negative early/idle/cancel behavior and finite completion. The separate pier planner in this raw run fails and is not accepted. Nearby initial setup is explicit.

nativeProofs.label: Actual entry-to-terminal-disc traversal
nativeProofs.scope: 192.589 m with the production controller, no pose writes, all34visitors/65buildings/1469colliders retained and actual terminal achievement. Source retaining-wall cap is corrected beneath the existing raised deck. No completed reload or full thumbstick route claim.
